description: Operator self-report on YOUR OWN claimed MCP listing: only the claimed QY may report; the figure is shown verbatim as 未经核实 (unverified); one identity counts once (dedup by QY); the self-report count never enters ranking or tier fields. [新路径] 条目运营者自报「用过」：**只有已认领的那个号**能报（未认领 ⇒ 拒绝并给明确 reason）；展示文案逐字含 **未经核实**；同一身份只算一次（去重按 QY）；自报数**不进**任何排序/档位字段；报告内容只给该认领号。

auth.description: Optional. Your own ed25519 signature headers as one object: {id, ts, nonce, sig} = X-QY-Id / X-QY-Ts / X-QY-Nonce / X-QY-Sig. Omit to use the session identity (auto-signed after qy_register).
